title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a worldwide record of reported shark incidents. Its reports include details such as when and where incidents happened, what people were doing, and the reported outcome.
Shark encounters can be dangerous, but attacks are uncommon and fatal attacks are rarer still. Dramatic stories can make sharks seem like a more frequent threat than they are for most people; looking at the records in context helps put that fear in perspective.
The Map page prepares the records with standardized country names and fatality labels. The Trends page summarizes reports by activity and shows activities with at least 50 incidents.
